name: Nikaidou Ai
source:
Likes: [url=/c21214]Yuuma[/url], bikes
Dislikes: Nothing
Favorite food: Miso soup
Dislikes food: Bitter foods

[url=/c1793]Shinku's[/url] twin sister. She never leaves someone alone if she finds that the child is in trouble. Always has a smile on her face. Her specialty, or belief, is to bring a smile to someone's face. Quite energetic, despite her petite body. She's in love with her childhood friend Yuuma.

[spoiler]Nikaidou Ai (along with Nikaidou Sora) are actually two parts of the soul of the "original" Haku who was the mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c1792]the Ren who took Kanoue Yuuma's name[/url]. Ai's soul is the continuation of Haku's soul after leaving her bad memories behind and reincarnating.[/spoiler]
